#!/usr/bin/python3
"""Capture original env fixtures in an owned Chrome Agent Screen.

--screen NAME --profile /var/tmp/OWNED/profile --out /var/tmp/OWNED/chrome.json
Start Chrome through olo-screen/olo-chrome with remote-debugging-port=0.
Native Wayland scales are changed live; no device emulation or site acceptance.
The new passive fixture tab is closed and screen settings restored afterward.
"""
import argparse
import time
import select
import copy
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shlex
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import urllib.request

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd() / 'tools' / 'browser'))
from cdp import Connection

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
parser.add_argument('--screen', required=True)
parser.add_argument('--profile', type=Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument('--out', type=Path, required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
assert os.environ.get('OLO_SCREEN') == args.screen
profile = args.profile.resolve()
assert profile.is_relative_to('/var/tmp') and args.out.resolve().is_relative_to('/var/tmp')


def run(*arguments):
    return subprocess.check_output(['olo-screen', *map(str, arguments)], text=True)


def free():
    run('wait', args.screen, '--free')


def ipc(body):
    if body['type'] != 'get_settings':
        free()
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX) as stream:
        stream.connect(os.environ['OLO_SOCKET'])
        stream.sendall((json.dumps(body) + '\n').encode())
        return json.loads(stream.makefile().readline())


deadline = time.monotonic() + 15
browser = None
while True:
    try:
        port = int((profile / 'DevToolsActivePort').read_text().splitlines()[0])
        endpoint = f'http://127.0.0.1:{port}'
        browser = Connection(json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(endpoint + '/json/version', timeout=1))['webSocketDebuggerUrl'], timeout=3)
        pid = next(p['id'] for p in browser.call('SystemInfo.getProcessInfo')['processInfo'] if p['type'] == 'browser')
        if any(w['pid'] == pid and w['app_id'] == 'google-chrome' for w in json.loads(run('windows', args.screen))):
            break
    except (OSError, EOFError):
        pass
    if browser:
        browser.close()
        browser = None
    assert time.monotonic() < deadline, 'Owned Chrome startup was not verified'
    time.sleep(.1)
command = [a.decode() for a in Path(f'/proc/{pid}/cmdline').read_bytes().split(b'\0') if a]
if len(command) == 1:
    command = shlex.split(command[0])
assert f'--user-data-dir={profile}' in command
version = browser.call('Browser.getVersion')
rows, page, target_id = [], None, None
try:
    free()
    target_id = browser.call('Target.createTarget', url='about:blank')['targetId']
    target = next(t for t in json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(endpoint + '/json')) if t['id'] == target_id)
    page = Connection(target['webSocketDebuggerUrl'], timeout=40)
    free()
    page.call('Page.enable')
    free()
    navigation = page.call('Page.navigate', url='https://stripe.com/')
    assert not navigation.get('errorText'), navigation
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 35
    while True:
        try:
            state = page.call('Runtime.evaluate', expression='JSON.stringify({url:location.href,ready:document.readyState})', returnByValue=True)
            state = json.loads(state['result']['value'])
            if state['url'].startswith('https://stripe.com/') and state['ready'] == 'complete':
                break
        except RuntimeError as error:
            assert 'context' in str(error).lower(), error
        assert time.monotonic() < deadline, 'Stripe did not load; no inventory accepted'
        time.sleep(.1)
    free()
    expression = """(()=>{const fields=['display','flexDirection','flexWrap','width','height','minWidth','maxWidth','minHeight','maxHeight','flexBasis','flexGrow','flexShrink','order','alignItems','alignSelf','justifyContent','alignContent','rowGap','columnGap','boxSizing','writingMode','containerType'];const info=e=>{const s=getComputedStyle(e);return {tag:e.localName,id:e.id,classes:[...e.classList].slice(0,12),textLength:e.textContent.length,rect:e.getBoundingClientRect().toJSON(),style:Object.fromEntries(fields.map(k=>[k,s[k]]))}};return JSON.stringify({url:location.href,dpr:devicePixelRatio,viewport:{width:innerWidth,height:innerHeight},ready:document.readyState,fonts:document.fonts.status,at:performance.now(),flexes:[...document.querySelectorAll('*')].filter(e=>['flex','inline-flex'].includes(getComputedStyle(e).display)&&e.getClientRects().length).slice(0,20).map(e=>({...info(e),children:[...e.children].slice(0,12).map(info)}))})})()"""
    reply = page.call('Runtime.evaluate', expression=expression, returnByValue=True)
    assert 'exceptionDetails' not in reply, reply
    result = json.loads(reply['result']['value'])
    assert result['url'].startswith('https://stripe.com/') and result['flexes'], result
    args.out.write_text(json.dumps(dict(scope='Read-only initial live Stripe flex inventory, no frozen replay or pixel/site acceptance. No text, account or payment interaction.',version=version,**result),indent=2)+'\n')
    print('Captured',len(result['flexes']),'live flex contexts')
finally:
    if page:
        page.close()
    if target_id:
        free()
        browser.call('Target.closeTarget', targetId=target_id)
    free()
    try:
        browser.call('Browser.close')
    except EOFError:
        pass
    browser.close()
    try:
        fd = os.pidfd_open(pid)
    except ProcessLookupError:
        pass
    else:
        assert select.select([fd], [], [], 10)[0], 'Owned Chrome did not exit'
        os.close(fd)
